  • Field Details

    • passportEnable

      public BooleanProperty passportEnable
      passportEnable allows to read passport booklet in TD3 size. The data of the machine-readable zone consists of two rows of 44 characters each.

    • idEnable

      public BooleanProperty idEnable
      idEnable allows to read official travel document in TD1 size. The data of the machine-readable zone consists of three rows of 30 characters each.

    • confidence

      public NumericProperty confidence
      confidence allows to set minimum confidence used by the OCR algorithm. An higher confidence decreases misdecoding probabilities.

    • multiframe

      public NumericProperty multiframe
      multiframe specifies how many decoded frames must match before accepting OCR data.

    • td2Enable

      public BooleanProperty td2Enable
      td2Enable allows to read the TD2 OCR format. The data of the machine-readable zone consists of two rows of 36 characters each.

    • mrvaEnable

      public BooleanProperty mrvaEnable
      mrvaEnable allows to read the MRV-A OCR format. The data of the machine-readable zone consists of two rows of 44 characters each.

    • mrvbEnable

      public BooleanProperty mrvbEnable
      mrvbEnable allows to read the MRV-B OCR format. The data of the machine-readable zone consists of two rows of 36 characters each.

    • enable

      public BooleanProperty enable
      enable enables or disables the symbology.

    • userID

      public CharacterProperty userID
      userID specifies the symbology identifier (if any).
      The symbology identifier is sent with the label when the global decode property Formatting.sendCodeId is set to SendCodeID.USERDEFINED_IDENTIFIER_BEFORE_LABEL or SendCodeID.USERDEFINED_IDENTIFIER_AFTER_LABEL.
